price_anchor: 2025 annual average unit price from source workbook mapped to the sales-weighted 2025 mean model index
future_launches: Recalculated with current-year and next-year sales using the unchanged portfolio engine; terminal 2031 sales equal 2030.
numerator: Mortgage transaction value includes down payment. Full annual nominal for 2027+; forecast Q4 nominal only for 2026.
denominator: 2026 forecast Q4 mean proxy price weighted by calendar days; 2027+ full-year arithmetic mean monthly proxy price.
caveats: A numerical fixed point is not evidence of econometric forecast accuracy. Unit-price/index anchoring and annual-to-monthly bridge are assumptions. Earlier dummy dates remain provisional. Mortgage ruble amounts are fixed, with no extra affordability elasticity.
